name: aiguard-workspace
description: Local-first data boundary for AI applications and agents

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/core --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/core-wasm/generated --out-name aiguard_core --release && node scripts/prepare-wasm.mjs
scripts.build:ts: tsc -b packages/rules-base packages/rules-vi packages/core-wasm packages/sdk packages/cli
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:rules
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy -p aiguard-core --all-targets -- -D warnings && tsc -b --pretty false
scripts.check:desktop: npm run build:desktop && cargo check -p aiguard-desktop
